---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Cherry defect
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## What happened

Describe the visible behavior and the honest state Cherry should have shown.

## Reproduction

List the smallest steps, route, browser, viewport, and whether a runner or WebMCP host was attached.
Do not paste secrets, tokens, private source text, or personal history.

## Evidence

Include console text or a screenshot with private material removed. Name the regression test that
could prevent this from returning.

## Gates

Paste the relevant `npm run gates` or focused test output if you can reproduce locally.

## Claims and boundaries

Does the bug make any UI or documentation claim exceed what the product actually did? Note any
approval, provenance, network, privacy, or runner boundary involved.
